title: War for Eden- RTS
author: Equal-Instance6456
selftext:
I am a solo dev using AI to help me build a game with mechanics from all  my favorite RTS games... im using claude  and i used meshy to make the character models   
  
 War For Eden will be a cosmic horror RTS for the first game.   
you will be playing as a flood like/Xenomorph type faction.   
you will drag bodies back to your base to produce more units... meaning the more you kill the more the gain ... for the first game im focusing on the big bad of a  trilogy   
you will be playing as a queen of a hivemind  jumping planets and consuming the life on it. the core game will be of her time on Eden. 

you will have to build your brood consume the land  and its wild life and bring Eden to its knees.   
im taking inspiration from games like AVP:extinction/Halo wars/Warhammer  
units will evole and there will be a story rich enviorment as you try to take hold of the planet   
  
tell me what you think and what you would like to see  this is the current build

comments.author: Nervous_Teach_5596
comments.body: Looks like StarCraft but bare-bones (really a prototype)

replies.author: Equal-Instance6456
replies.body:
I did play a bit of the web versions of star craft the flash games of it... Never got to play the real version.  
But I did like the feel I got from those.

I have a plan to make 3 game series with this. 
The first game you will be playing as the big bad of it. 
The second game will be more about recovery from the tragedy you commited while playing as these guys.
3erd game your gonna take the fight to their homeworld.
